prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Katy, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1239; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision you reported in Katy, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your full name and the address where you currently receive mail.

A: I'd rather just give the address for now. It's a house off a residential street in Katy.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were driving and what you were doing just before the impact?

A: I was heading east on a main road, traveling in the right lane at about the speed limit. Traffic had been moving steadily, then it slowed up ahead of me.

Q: When you slowed, what happened next?

A: I came to a stop behind a car that was already stopped. A moment later I felt a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped forward and then back against the headrest.

Q: Did you see the vehicle that struck you before the impact?

A: No. I was looking forward at the brake lights ahead. I only saw it in the mirror after it hit.

Q: Did you get out of your vehicle at the scene?

A: Yes, I stepped out to check the damage. The other driver got out too and we exchanged information.

Q: Since the collision, what physical symptoms have you experienced?

A: My neck is stiff and sore, and there's a dull ache across my lower back that gets worse when I sit for a long time. I've been taking over-the-counter pain relievers and I saw a doctor who diagnosed neck and back strain.

Q: Have you missed any work or daily activities because of these symptoms?

A: I've had to take a few shorter shifts and I can't lift anything heavy around the house right now.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I want to make sure my treatment is covered. I'm following the doctor's instructions.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
